coverage: Every whole positive-area building or building:part intersecting the exact configured core or 600 m source ring. Multipolygon inner rings retained; named model exclusions are exact source IDs.
nativeUnitsNote: This snapshot has no unit-bearing literal building height/min-height/roof-height strings. Strict imperial ft/in parsing is covered by shared native-profile regression fixtures; this dataset does not demonstrate a unit-bearing source example.

visibleRing.exclusionReason: Covered/tunnel source ways outside the physical core are not represented as ground scenery; no elevation or open road is invented.

conflictPolicy: Raw detections remain visible for source/access/layer/width classification; no source body or road was removed or moved to clear a default ribbon.
remainingGates: Actual drive/foot/drone and full-traffic mirror hotspot budgets
Complete north-up 250 m game-only atlas and actual 150 m edge views
Full Street View comparison images and reviewed coverage ledger
placesScope: Every compiled POI matched independently to an original OSM node/polygon centroid or explicit official locator within 0.08 m output quantization tolerance. This does not claim every nearby-ring trading unit is rendered.

strictDimensionAudit.provenanceNote: Literal heights/minima and storey counts are source facts; storey-derived metre estimates are not literal OSM heights.

openSourceCanopies.sourceClassification: literal original OSM building=roof/carport or building:part=roof
openSourceCanopies.verticalDimensions: Explicit estimates unless original positive source height/min_height wins. No layer-to-metres conversion.

unresolvedPassageDatums.policy: Original relative layer/level retained; no physical metre datum is inferred and no ground opening is cut.

roofShapeReview.note: Explicit OSM roof shape wins. Unsupported quadruple_saltbox remains a reported profile issue; it is not asserted to be an exact native shape. Uncertain aerial shapes and estimated rise/pitch remain estimates.
